record_title: Spectral-orbit divisibility for algebraic isometries of vector Hardy spaces
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Two especially relevant full articles, Botelho–Jamison (2015) on algebraic properties of isometry groups on vector-valued function spaces and Botelho–Ilišević (2021) on finite-spectrum isometries, were not inspected in full; their available abstracts do not state the Hardy-space disk-symbol divisor theorem, but equivalent coverage in the uninspected text remains the principal originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
